description: Choose which agents may be in this company's chats — the company's owner only (PM-1247). 'all': every agent switched on; 'none': no agent anywhere — none may be put in or called, and those already in chats answer nobody; 'chosen': only the agents named in 'roles' (the whole list — one not named is barred). Takes effect at once, a call already waiting included. A line in the company's journal says from what to what.

roles.description: With 'chosen': the agents let in, by key or handle.

name: set_chat_agent_policy
title: Set chat agent policy
